description: Lists the services a business has configured, with their prices and the exact arguments to quote each one. Call this BEFORE get_quote: the service name must match a configured service. offer_available means an exact quote can return an offer_id for reserve_slot. payable additionally means the current MCP booking configuration supports a deposit; follow reserve_slot payment.required. Neither field guarantees a time or authorizes payment. Unmatched or unpriced services return no price and no offer; ask the business through get_booking_destination. A business that sells goods through its own store has nothing payable here and returns store_url, a link to its website, when one can be given.
name: list_services

offer_available.description: An exact quote can create an offer for reserve_slot; not a booking or payment guarantee.

payable.description: The current MCP booking configuration supports a deposit for this price. Follow reserve_slot payment.required; this does not authorize payment.

store_url.description: Goods stores only: the link to the store's own website, through Advocate. Not a product page, a cart or a checkout.

title: List Services
